controlsRationale: Arrow keys select original menus and steer Classic/Walls/FruitPower. Swap Arrows intentionally reverses the original directions. Enter selects, original Q backs out of mode/rules screens, Escape returns from active play to main menu and exits from main menu. Reserved landscape panel with arrow pad, Enter/Escape and an explicit Back(Q) action; no unnecessary mouse pad/direct preset.
